# Lieflat Charts — derived source

`scripts/issue-html/chart.mjs` adapts one renderer from Lieflat Charts (made at moxt.ai):

- Gallery: `templates/basics-gallery.html` (Lupi Basics)
- Chart: F5 Tick Rows — card "Six teams, shipped and counted"
- Renderer: `// ════ C1 · tick rows ════`
- Tokens: Mono (`mono-tokens.js`): INK #1C1C1A, PAPER #F0EFEB, MUTED #8F8E88, FAINT #C6C5BF, GRID #DEDDD6

Lieflat Charts is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (`LICENSE`, copied unchanged). That license
does not grant commercial-use rights; confirm the user's actual rights before commercial distribution. No Chart.js,
ECharts or Inter files are bundled (see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`); the chart uses system sans-serif fallbacks.
